THE PERSON BEHIND THE WORK

Listening first.
Building from there.

My career began at Banglalink, where customer service taught me to listen closely, understand the problem behind a complaint and turn feedback into practical action.

At Aarong Dairy, that customer perspective became the foundation for brand communication, national campaigns and digital commerce. I coordinated people, creative partners and operational teams to connect what the brand promised with what customers experienced.

Care Nutrition expanded my experience in portfolio positioning, product launches and digital marketing. Today, at Grameen Danone, I bring those experiences together across brand and sales operations—connecting consumer insight with the everyday work of Sales, Factory and Supply Chain.
